intro.h2: Tile done right, explained step by step
paragraphs: Aguirre's Tile Services handles tile installation Forney homeowners book again and again. The crew covers all types of tile floors, bath tubs, walk-in showers, backsplashes, walls and fireplaces. Backsplash installation is the job reviewers mention most, with 12 reviews on Google so far.

What clients write about is Manny. He explains the whole process before he starts, gives straight advice on the best options, and goes out of his way to finish on time. Two reviewers end the same way: they will call him again the next time they need tile work. You pick the tile, and Aguirre's handles the rest.

items.name: Kitchen backsplashes
items.blurb: The most reviewed job on Aguirre's Google profile, with 12 reviews about backsplash installation. One client hired Manny to replace an old kitchen backsplash and called it an excellent job. Recent work includes a white patterned tile backsplash behind white and navy cabinets.

image.alt: Kitchen with white cabinets, navy lower cabinets, white quartz counters and a white patterned tile backsplash

items.name: Walk-in showers
items.blurb: Walk-in showers with large-format wall tile, built-in niches with mosaic accents, and glass-tile or marble-look finishes. Recent showers include a green glass subway tile shower with a pebble floor and a gray stone-look shower with two tiled niches.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with large gray stone-look tile laid in a staggered pattern, mosaic niches and black valve

items.name: Tile floors
items.blurb: All types of tile floors: large marble-look planks, patterned cement-look tile, gray porcelain and herringbone. One Facebook before and after shows a kitchen covered in broken old tile, then finished with white marble-look planks. Floors for kitchens, bathrooms, halls and living areas.

image.alt: Large gray marble-look porcelain floor tile with straight grout lines in an open hallway

items.name: Bathroom tile replacement
items.blurb: Tired bathroom floors and tub surrounds replaced with clean marble-look tile. Michelle had the tile in her second bathroom replaced, and Michael had his bathroom floor tile redone. Both said Manny explained the process and finished on time.

image.alt: Tub surround tiled in large white marble-look porcelain tile above a white alcove tub

items.name: Fireplaces and accent walls
items.blurb: Tile is not just for kitchens and baths. Aguirre's also tiles fireplaces and feature walls, including brick-look tile laid in a running bond pattern. Ask about tiling a fireplace surround or an accent wall when you book your estimate.

image.alt: Wall finished in multi-tone brick-look tile laid in a running bond pattern

items.title: 56 reviews, all five stars
items.text: Every one of the 56 Google reviews is five stars. Backsplash installation comes up in 12, with herringbone patterns, shower remodels and free estimates also mentioned.

items.title: Finished on time

about.text: Aguirre's Tile Services is a tile contractor on University Drive in Forney, Texas, and tile is all it does: floors, bath tubs, walk-in showers, backsplashes, walls, fireplaces and more. Manny is the name you will see in review after review. Clients call him punctual, professional and a great communicator who gives excellent advice. The company's approach is simple: you choose the tile and the design, and Aguirre's takes care of the rest, from tear-out to the last grout line. With 56 five-star reviews, many customers say they will call again.

process.h2: How tile installation Forney projects work

steps.title: Call for a free estimate
steps.text: Call (214) 407-2403 or email aguirretile@gmail.com and describe the floor, shower, backsplash or fireplace you want tiled.

steps.title: In-home measure
steps.text: Aguirre's sends its flooring expert to measure the area to be tiled and gives you a free estimate on the project.

steps.title: You choose the tile
steps.text: Pick the tile and the pattern. Manny gives advice on the best options and explains the whole process before work starts.

steps.title: Schedule and install
steps.text: Once you approve the estimate, the job is scheduled. The old tile comes out and the new tile goes in, on time as promised.

service_area.text: Aguirre's Tile Services is based on University Drive in Forney, Texas, the town named on its Google profile and Facebook page. Forney homeowners can call for a free in-home estimate. If you live outside Forney and are not sure whether you are in range, call (214) 407-2403 with your address and the project, and the team will let you know.

items.a: Yes. Aguirre's Tile Services offers free estimates. The company sends its flooring expert to your home to measure the area to be tiled and gives you a free estimate on the project. If you approve it, your installation is scheduled. Call (214) 407-2403 to set it up.

items.q: What kinds of tile work do you do?
items.a: All types of tile floors, bath tubs, walk-in showers, backsplashes, walls and fireplaces. Kitchen backsplashes are the job mentioned most in Google reviews, followed by herringbone patterns, shower remodels and bathroom floor tile replacement. If it is tile, ask about it.

items.q: Will you remove my old tile?
items.a: Yes. Tile replacement jobs start with tearing out the old tile, as in the before and after photos of a kitchen floor where broken old tile covered the room before new marble-look planks went down. Manny explains each step before work starts.

items.q: How long will my project take?
items.a: It depends on the size of the job, and Manny will tell you when he gives you the plan. Reviewers consistently say he finished on time as promised, with one noting he went out of his way to finish the project on schedule.

Monday to Friday 9 AM to 6 PM and Saturday 9 AM to 12 PM. Closed Sunday. You can also email aguirretile@gmail.com with photos of your space and the tile you like, and the team will follow up to book your free estimate.

final_cta.text: Call for a free in-home estimate on your floor, shower or backsplash.
